title: KBA ECE R124 approval 000088 - Otto Fuchs wheel type 37028 (10 J x 18 H2 ET65)
publisher: Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt (KBA); published by Otto Fuchs KG
notes: ECE Regulation No. 124 communication issued by the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt (E1, approval number 000088, dated 16.11.2012) for the Otto Fuchs KG forged aluminium wheel type 37028, published on the Fuchs website together with the TUV NORD test report and its application annex. Downloaded and read as text on 2026-10-15; no copy is kept in the repository. The wheel data state rim contour 10 J x 18 H2, inset ET 65 mm, 5 holes on a 130 mm pitch circle, 15 mm bolt holes, centre bore 71.58 mm with centre centring, tested wheel load 625 kg. The application annex for Porsche lists Porsche 911 Carrera (type 993, body width 1735 mm and Turbo-Look 1795 mm) with 265/35ZR18 and 993 Turbo except GT2 with 285/30ZR18; axle 2 only, combined with 37027 (approval 000087) on axle 1; the Turbo-Look and Turbo rows require the factory 25 mm rear spacer; the vehicle-side column for these rows reads 5/130/71,5, the hub pattern and centring diameter of the vehicle, which is not the wheel centre bore. Inline component citation: COMP-FUCHS-37028.011 (catalog/components). A type approval states approved fitment and declared wheel data; it gives no wheel profile, seat geometry or tolerance and is not a manufacturing drawing. Wheels are a safety class: nothing here allows a wheel to be made or released. The 71.58 mm versus 71.5 mm attribution is tracked in catalog/registers/contradictions.json.
